description_en: One rattan and bamboo household product. Front: A round bamboo frame holds a fine blank stainless-steel sieve insert beneath a woven rim. Side: The shallow cylindrical frame includes one plain hanging loop. Rear: The rear exposes the secured mesh edge and uninterrupted lower hoop. Smooth bound joints, visibly interlaced natural fibers, empty clean inserts where specified. No writing, numbers, logos, marks, labels or other objects.
prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE original photorealistic Vietnamese rattan/bamboo studio catalog product. Subject: One rattan and bamboo household product. Front: A round bamboo frame holds a fine blank stainless-steel sieve insert beneath a woven rim. Side: The shallow cylindrical frame includes one plain hanging loop. Rear: The rear exposes the secured mesh edge and uninterrupted lower hoop. Smooth bound joints, visibly interlaced natural fibers, empty clean inserts where specified. No writing, numbers, logos, marks, labels or other objects.. Style Boho: organic graceful curves and restrained craft detail. Relative size generous within its class, no measurements. Main woven surfaces: close herringbone V-shaped twill. Finish: natural matte honey-tan fibers. Believable smooth bindings, continuous strips, wood/bamboo support only where described, and only specified plain secondary materials. Do not add rigid frames or legs to flexible mats or other products that do not specify them. All interiors empty. CAMERA: exact straight-on FRONT ELEVATION at azimuth zero, directly facing its described front feature, allowing a modest downward elevation for a low horizontal product so its woven surface is visible. Keep its natural resting orientation; never stand mats or trivets upright. No three-quarter azimuth or overhead angle. This is the canonical FRONT image for subsequent views of the same design. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. Plain warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft lighting and subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture. Square image. No props, room, people, animals, food, plants, detached extra products, collage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE: no letters, numbers, words, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, measurements or inscriptions.
